_comment: Segments: beachhead (Israel/Hebrew/Israeli groups abroad -- where UPE genuinely competes), expansion (Spain/Spanish/Europe -- an /es site and a Barcelona office with zero coverage in the old battery), aspirational (global head terms against GPJ/Freeman/Maritz -- reported separately, never averaged into the headline), branded (names the company; measures recall only, excluded from the headline). Replaces 2026-07-05.1, whose 16 questions were 7 global head terms plus 4 branded guaranteed hits -- a battery that could not show a breakthrough because it did not ask about the market UPE can win. Scores are NOT comparable across battery_version.
